_meta.description: Line 4's stations in order from Bhakti Park (Wadala), as MMRDA's Line 4 page lists them, then the two stations of the Line 4A extension to Gaimukh. 'section' is '4' or '4A'. 'phase' is the order of opening reported for the line, not an MMRDA phase name: 1 Cadbury Junction to Gaimukh, 2 Gandhi Nagar to Mahapalika Marg, 3 Bhakti Park to Surya Nagar (Free Press Journal, 22 Sep 2025, reported). 'dpr_chainage_m' is the chainage in the project reports (Line 4, May 2016; Line 4A, Oct 2017), from Bhakti Park. 'kml_name' is the station's point in MMRDA's alignment file. Positions and along_m come from scripts/build-alignment-line4.py. 'dropped_stations' were in the 2016 plan and are not on MMRDA's list now. 'same_site_as' names a station of another line at the same place.

location.method: MMRDA alignment file for Line 4 (KML on the Metro Influence Zone page, uploaded March 2025): point "BHAKTI PARK (M) STATION". along_m is measured along a centre line derived from MMRDA's corridor polygon, from Bhakti Park station; the point is 9 m from that line.

interchanges.notes: The 2016 project report puts the station on Mono Rail Depot Road, opposite Bhakti Park Monorail station, with one entrance in front of it. In MMRDA's alignment files (Mar 2025) the two station points are 155 m apart.
